bull_bear.body: Net cash position of INR 147.7cr. Management actively evaluating inorganic M&A opportunities in both BPM and T&D segments to accelerate strategy, though no specific targets disclosed.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body: AI disruption leading to client headcount reduction (management monitors closely); Macro delays in large BPM deal closures; Dependency on new customer acquisition (90% of T&D growth) vs. plateauing existing base; Currency volatility reversals.
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Confident and strategic. New CEO emphasizes 'technology enablement over FTE business,' acknowledging short-term revenue trade-offs for long-term margin quality. Transparent about rationalizing low-margin work.
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body: 90% of T&D volume growth is from entirely new customers, indicating existing client volumes have plateaued; Revenue growth outpaced payroll volume growth due to one-time configuration charges and higher international realization, not just volume.
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

bull_bear.body:
- Balance sheet is net-cash-oriented: ~₹160 Cr cash and liquid funds (₹160.5 Cr in Q1 FY27 vs ₹158.4 Cr in Q1 FY26 and ₹147.7 Cr in Q4 FY26).
- Surplus cash is being parked, not deployed into capex: "Cash & Liquid funds higher on account of increase in investments by ₹12 Cr in Q1 FY27 was driven by deployment of surplus cash into short-term investment instruments".
- Finance cost is rising against that cash position - ₹3.7 Cr in Q1 FY27, up 93.7% YoY and 38.6% QoQ - with no explanation given in the deck.
- No dividend, buyback, debt or capital-allocation policy is mentioned anywhere in the deck.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

bull_bear.body:
- 25-year legacy with deep domain knowledge in BPM and T&D, evidenced by 97.1% revenue retention rate in FY26.
- AI embedment across operations and products, including proprietary Digicollect 2.0 platform and AI-native HCM SaaS, repositioning the company from labour-arbitrage to outcome-led, AI-augmented services.
- Global delivery footprint across three countries with multi-lingual capabilities (11 Indian languages, 12+ international languages), enabling service to 69 markets.
- Strong international momentum with 71% of T&D deal wins from international markets and 61% of ACV from international/MCP opportunities.
bull_bear.title: Bull — competitive strengths

bull_bear.body:
- Foreign exchange fluctuation risk — The Company explicitly references 'Exchange Fluctuations' in the MD&A, indicating exposure to currency volatility that could impact financial performance.
- Concentration of promoter holding — Promoter companies hold 73.39% of equity, which may lead to governance risks and limited influence for minority shareholders.
- Geographic concentration of operations — All 8 offices/service delivery centres are located in India (Chennai, Bengaluru, Noida), with subsidiaries only in the USA and Philippines, potentially exposing the Company to regional disruptions.
- No credit rating or debt securities — The Company has not issued debt securities or commercial papers and has not opted for any credit rating, which may limit access to debt markets and signal a lack of external credit assessment.
- No outstanding convertible instruments or warrants — The absence of any GDRs/ADRs/Warrants or convertible instruments may limit capital-raising flexibility in the future.
- Dependence on key subsidiaries — Operations rely on subsidiaries in the USA and Philippines; any adverse developments in these jurisdictions could materially affect the Company.
bull_bear.title: Bear — key risks

business.title: Challenges → beneficiaries & losers

business.body:
- Deck's own summary line: "Alldigi Tech delivered steady margin expansion with rising international contribution in Q1 FY27, while scaling AI-led platforms across Tech & Digital and BPM."
- Two reported segments: BPM at ₹109.7 Cr / 73.0% of the Q1 FY27 revenue mix and Tech & Digital at ₹40.6 Cr / 27.0%, with T&D the structurally higher-margin business (42.9% segment margin vs BPM's 11.9%, both excluding unallocated corporate cost per the deck's note).
- Geography mix is the stated strategic axis: International revenue at 68.8% in Q1 FY27, up from 65.2% YoY (chart shows International ₹103.4 Cr / 69% vs Domestic ₹46.9 Cr / 31%), with international revenue up 10.3% YoY.
- Slide headline states "BPM's International Mix Rises to 81%" and that T&D "Sustains 40%+ Margins"; T&D segment margin is shown at 43.5%, 39.8%, 43.2%, 44.0% and 42.9% across Q1FY26 to Q1FY27.

- [Investor relations] The IR contacts named - Rajesh Lachhani, Head of IR & M&A, and Priya Philipose, Head - PR & Communication - are listed with @Digitide.com email addresses while the general IR mailbox is @alldigitech.com. The deck does not explain the relationship.
- [Exceptional item] The income statement shows Exceptional Items of ₹3.8 Cr in Q4 FY26 and nil in Q1 FY27, with Adj PAT of ₹32.7 Cr vs reported PAT ₹28.9 Cr for Q4 FY26; the deck does not describe what the exceptional item was.

business.body: Alldigi Tech Limited provides business process management (BPM) and technology & digital (T&D) services globally. BPM encompasses lead generation, customer retention, and relationship management including voice and non-voice processes, while T&D covers HRMS, payroll services, and time and attendance management. The company serves clients across 69 markets with a focus on embedding AI into operations and products.

outlook.body: Revenue: Mid-teens growth expected for FY27; Margin: 1-2% YoY improvement targeted (driven by mix shift & AI); Order Inflow: Strong ACV additions (INR 40.1cr T&D, INR 54.1cr BPM); Capex: Platform development (HRMS V2, AI modules).

outlook.body: HRO order book stands at 48% international exposure as of March 31, 2026. BPM pipeline includes large healthcare, international insurance, and collections deals delayed by macro uncertainty now expected to close in FY27.
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body: RCM business doubled in FTEs within a quarter; Launch of HRMS V2 (integrated console) and AI-based payroll analytics module to drive non-linear revenue per employee; Targeting step-growth via large global deals in healthcare/insurance.
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

outlook.body:
- Focus on delivering technology-driven business solutions across HR, finance, and compliance services, leveraging digital platforms and automation to enhance client productivity and operational efficiency.
- Expand global delivery footprint through subsidiaries in the USA and Philippines to serve international clients and diversify geographic revenue streams.
- Maintain a capital-light model with no debt securities or commercial papers issued, relying on internal accruals for growth and operations.
- The Group's objective for capital management is to maximise shareholder value, safeguard business continuity and support growth. Funding requirements are met through equity and operating cash flows. The Company has a Dividend Distribution Policy and declared two interim dividends during the year.
- Whistle-Blower Mechanism/Vigil Mechanism established to report unethical behaviour, fraud, or code of conduct violations, with direct access to the Audit Committee Chairperson.
outlook.title: Strategy & capital allocation

outlook.body: The Company has 8 offices/service delivery centres in India located at Chennai, Bengaluru and Noida. Subsidiaries include Alldigi Tech Inc located in the USA (Bedminster, New Jersey) and Alldigi Tech Manila Inc in the Philippines (Taguig City). No specific new capex projects, capacity additions, or expansion timelines are disclosed in the provided annual report text.
outlook.title: Capex & expansion plans

outlook.body:
- The Company does not deal in commodities, hence commodity price risk disclosure is not applicable, indicating a service-oriented business model insulated from direct commodity fluctuations.
- Foreign exchange risk is managed as detailed in the 'Exchange Fluctuations' section of the MD&A, suggesting international revenue exposure and active hedging or monitoring.
outlook.title: Demand & outlook drivers

deepdive.thesis: Alldigi Tech executed a strategic pivot in Q4FY26, sacrificing low-margin domestic BPM headcount to drive a 22.3% YoY surge in high-margin Tech & Digital revenue, resulting in expanded EBITDA margins (27.1%) despite flat overall top-line growth. The appointment of CEO Natarajan Laxsmanan signals an aggressive push toward AI-enabled platforms (HRMS V2) and international expansion, with 90% of HRO volume growth now driven by new logos rather than existing client expansion.
